upheld.detail: Lines 11 (blank-line whitespace), 40 (trailing spaces after Where), 50 (closing brace), 52-54 (blank line and GetCardTypesAsync spacing) change only whitespace and are not part of adding City/Country. The Implementation Notes say dotnet format required it, but the guideline counts formatter-produced
upheld.requirement: pr-check-style 'What to check' item 4: whitespace-only or formatting edits to untouched lines are unrelated changes (minor), even when a formatter produces them

upheld.title: overflow-wrap:anywhere + min-width:0 in the base rule still breaks short words mid-letter just above 480px
upheld.detail: The base .order-ships-to rule (min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere) applies at every width. The full-width line only starts at <=480px. At 481px: page-pad clamp(1rem,5vw,..) = 24px each side leaves about 433px; four 1.75rem gaps take 112px; flex 1 0 0 gives each of the five cells about 64px, narrowe
upheld.requirement: Upheld round-1 finding ui-ships-to-375-unreadable: only an unbroken long word should break
upheld.evidence: opus: src/WebApp/Components/Pages/User/Orders.razor.css:106-110 with .orders-item > div { flex: 1 0 0 } at :79-81 and gap 1.75rem at :73; --page-pad at src/WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css:318

dismissed.title: OrderRecord.City/Country declared string? unlike every other string in the record
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. A nullable annotation on a display-only record is a defensible choice; Address.City and Address.Country are always set in the domain, so no wrong result is reachable.
